LanguageData.DMS_CombatRation.label: C-Ration
LanguageData.DMS_CombatRation.description: A block of high-energy organic polymer ration, invented during the Third World War as a nutritional supplement for augmented human troops in combat and as an additive for artificial muscle culture media. For soldiers fitted with a nutrition port, a single ration provides enough calories and vitamins to keep their organs running for a long time.\n\nFor an ordinary person it works just as well, but may cause some mild gastrointestinal discomfort.
LanguageData.Neuroglue.label: Neuroglue
LanguageData.Neuroglue.description: A protein-like receptor gel that mediates between biological tissue and neural machinery. Injected intravenously into the circulatory system, it effectively blocks synthetic rejection and phantom limb syndrome, and each dose lowers xeno limb syndrome by one level. It can also render nanite infections benign.\n\nProducts like this have circulated on rimworlds and midworlds for decades, but every organization claiming to produce it has been sanctioned by the core worlds, who declare that such a product would raise the bionic level of pirates and seriously disrupt regional balance.
